sentences.text: Considered I.A.No.21245/2024, which is first application under Section 389(1) Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail on behalf of Aman @ Mantu Lodhi.

2. Vide impugned judgment dated 15.5.2023 passed by the Special Judge [SC/ST(PA) Act], Satna in SC(ATR)-18/2021 [State of M.P. Vs. Rijwan and others] the applicant/appellant No.2 (Aman @
Mantu Lodhi) has been convicted for offences under sections 450, 366, 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3(2)(v) of the SC & ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and sentenced to undergo R.I. for 07 years, 10 years, 20 years and For Life with fine of Rs.5000/-, Rs.5000/-,
Rs.10,000/- & Rs.10,000/- respectively with default stipulations.
3. It is the case of prosecution that between night of 23.12.2020 and 24.12.2020.

sentences.text: When the prosecutrix was alongwith her husband was sleeping at about 12.00 hours in midnight there was knock at the door of their house and when they saw that accused persons including present applicant was standing outside.
When they opened the door they abused them and said that they will commit rape of the prosecutrix and kill the husband of prosecutrix.
Thereafter, the prosecutrix asked her husband to go and call persons of the 2 CRA-10730-2023 locality for help.
Thereafter, the accused persons took the prosecutrix to the house of accused-Babu Basore and there they committed rape upon her.
They also threatened that if she lodges report they will kill her.
As per paragraph 3 of the judgment when the prosecutrix searched for her husband he was found in the house of Shivlal Choudhary.
For some days they did not report the crime to the Police out of fear and lodged report with the Police only on 28.12.2020.
During investigation DNA samples were taken.
The DNA was found positive for other two accused persons, namely, Rijwan and Babbu Basore only.
After trial the learned trial Court as per paragraph 76 acquitted co-accused/Krishna Saket, but convicted and sentenced the applicant as stated hereinabove.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant/applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.
The learned trial Court has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence on record.
There are material contradictions and omission.
The Prosecution Witnesses have not supported the prosecution story.
The medical evidence do not give specific opinion regarding commission of rape by present applicant.
There is no sign of any injury on the person of the prosecutrix.
The applicant has remained in custody for substantial period.
Hence, prayer has been made for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Learned Government Advocate has opposed the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
6. Considered the arguments and perused the record of the trial 3 CRA-10730-2023 Court.
As per Exhibit-P/41, which is a DNA report it is found that the DNA profile of the applicant does not match with the DNA profile of the prosecutrix.
During trial the applicant was bail.
Also taken into account that applicant remained in custody for 01.1.2021 too 11.4.2022 and thereafter from the date of judgment i.e. 15.5.2023 till date.

Further, considering that final disposal of instant appeal would take considerable time and there is no possibility of its early hearing, this Court is of the opinion that suspension of sentence can be granted.
Accordingly, without commenting finally on merits of the case, this application is allowed.

7. It is directed that that subject to depositing fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, the remaining part of the substantive jail sentence imposed upon appellant/Applicant (Aman @ Mantu Lodhi) shall remain suspended during the pendency of this case and he shall be released on bail.
Appellant shall appear before the concerned trial Court on 15.05.2025 and on all such subsequent dates, as may be fixed by the trial Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
8. List for final hearing in due course.

(SUSHRUT ARVIND DHARMADHIKARI) (AVANINDRA  JUDGE J  RM Rizwan @ Rajju Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148686733/
